entities.summary: Emelie Schepp is a Swedish crime author. Her crime novels are centered around Norrköping and focus on the main figure Jana Berzelius, a public prosecutor. An exception is Hundra dagar i juli (2024), about organ transplantation, which is set in her native town Motala.
